label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y toda abertura de asno redimirás con cordero, y si no redimes, y le romperás la cerviz; y todo primogénito de hombre en tus hijos redimirás.
spanish: Y todo primer nacido de asno redimirás con res del rebaño, y si no redimirás, y le romperás la cerviz; y todo primogénito de hombre en tus hijos redimirás.
grammarChanges: Replaced 'abertura' with 'primer nacido' at h02013013002 (construct with h02013013003, asno): פֶּטֶר (H6363) is the concrete firstling, matching the repair already applied at Éxodo 13:12.
Changed the article from 'toda' to 'todo' at h02013013001 to agree with the masculine 'nacido' introduced by that lexical repair.

Replaced 'cordero' with 'res del rebaño' at h02013013005: שֶׂה (H7716) is one of the flock (sheep or goat), common gender, age unspecified, matching the repair already applied at Éxodo 12:4; no article added since the Hebrew noun here is anarthrous (בְשֶׂה).
Changed 'redimes' (present) to 'redimirás' (future) at h02013013008 so the qal imperfect 2ms matches the tense already used for the same verb (פדה) at h02013013004.
